license_summary.furbearer_permit: Furbearer Permit required to chase, hunt, or trap furbearers ($5 individual per the license application).
license_summary.trapper_education: Trapper education required for trappers who did not hold a permit/certificate before Aug 1, 2007.
license_summary.shipping_tag: Fur Shipping Tag required for pelts/carcasses transported across the state line (via MD Outdoors/COMPASS).
license_summary.otter_carcass: Whole skinned carcass of any river otter taken in Allegany or Garrett counties must be submitted to the Wildlife and Heritage Service: (301) 777-2136.
license_summary.gray_fox_registration: Gray fox: register within 48 hours via MD Outdoors or (410) 260-8900 (NEW 2026-27).
license_summary.sunday: Sunday hunting for certain furbearers is permitted with restrictions in some counties/locations (see the Sunday hunting chart).
license_summary.wma_leaseholders: On DNR lands in Caroline, Dorchester, Somerset, Talbot, Wicomico, and Worcester counties, only leaseholders or their appointees may hunt or trap furbearers Nov 15–Mar 15.

verification.confirmation_notes: 2026-2027 Maryland Guide to Hunting & Trapping, Furbearer Seasons & Limits (DNR via eRegulations). Beaver trapping Dec 15-Mar 15 (Dec 1-Mar 15 Allegany/Garrett), no limit; bobcat closed statewide; coyote firearms/archery/airgun hunting year-round statewide day/night; coyote trapping Oct 31-Feb 15 east of Bay/Susquehanna, Nov 14-Feb 28 west (CONFLICT flagged); fisher and long-tailed weasel Oct 31-Feb 1 statewide, 4/day & 4/season; red & gray fox Aug 1-Jul 31 Charles/Dorchester, Nov 14-Feb 28 eastern-shore group, Oct 31-Feb 15 western/central group; muskrat & mink trapping in three county groups (Nov 14-Feb 15 / Jan 1-Mar 15 / Dec 15-Mar 15); river otter trapping Dec 15-Mar 15 (10/10 general; 2/2 central group; Dec 1-Mar 15 Allegany/Garrett 2/2 per proposal, flagged); raccoon & opossum hunting Oct 15-Mar 15 statewide day/night, trapping Nov 14-Mar 15 east / Oct 31-Mar 15 west; skunk hunting Oct 31-Mar 15 statewide, trapping same east/west split; gray fox 48-hour registration (new); otter carcass submission (Allegany/Garrett); fur shipping tags; WMA leaseholder rule.
known_gaps: COYOTE EAST/WEST CONFLICT: final guide assigns Oct 31-Feb 15 to EAST and Nov 14-Feb 28 to WEST, but the DNR proposal and 2024-2026 COMAR assign the earlier season to WEST. Modeled per the final guide; MUST verify against current COMAR 08.03.03.05 before launch.
Otter Allegany/Garrett limits (2/day, 2/season) follow the DNR proposal; the final table's cells did not extract cleanly. Verify against COMAR.
Fisher hunting methods (firearms/archery/airgun) and weasel trapping-only status follow the DNR proposal's method labels; the final table merges the rows. Verify against COMAR.
Fisher/otter 15-day pelt-tagging rule carried from the 2024-2025 guide; re-verify for 2026-2027.
Woodchuck year-round rule carried from the 2024-2025 guide (unprotected mammal); re-verify.
Nutria omitted: 2026-2027 final table does not list it and the guide calls nutria eradicated in MD.
Scientific names are standard taxonomy, NOT stated in the guide; all marked scientific_name_verified=false.
